english.title: Operator / pilot permit aircraft to make flight in contravention of direction made by CAA / authorised person
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the

(A)_[operator]_
(B)_[pilot in command]_

of an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), permitted the aircraft to make a flight, namely **(..SPECIFY FLIGHT..), when directed by

(C)_[the CAA]_
(D)_[an authorised person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..)]_

under article 257(1) of the Air Navigation Order 2016 not to

(E)_[do so]_
(F)_[permit a flight of a specified description, namely **(..SPECIFY FLIGHT DESCRIPTION..)]_

until the direction had been revoked by the CAA or an authorised person
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 257(3) and 265(7) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being the operator or pilot in command of an aircraft,
permitted the aircraft to make a flight when directed by the CAA or an authorised person
under article 257(1) of the Order not to do so or permit a flight of a specified description
until the direction had been revoked by the CAA or an authorised person.
